newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier boosts Global Express range.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier boosts Global Express range.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Monday that it boosted the non-stop range of its Global Express business jet by three percent.

Flying at its long-range cruise speed of Mach 0.80, the Global Express currently offers a non-stop range of 6,700 nautical miles (12,408 km), a three percent increase from its previous range of 6,500 nautical miles (12,038 km).

The new range give the Global Express "the longest legs in corporate aviation," the company said. It will connect more major cities than any other business jet, including Los Angeles-Brisbane (6,694 nm), New York-Cape Town (6,605 nm), Paris-Santiago (6,676 mnm) and Hong Kong-Chicago (6,680).

By November 13, the prototype Global Express had accumulated 37 hours during 15 flights at Bombardier's Test Flight Centre in Wichita, Kan., and the altitude envelope has been extended to 41,000 feet (12,497 metres), the company said. -- Reuters Montreal bureau (514) 985-2434
